topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
consensus_response: Defocused reflector gain loss reduces peak SNR due to broader beam patterns and higher spillover losses, but offers robustness against feed failures. Mitigation techniques like phase-only beamforming and polarization diversity can optimize SNR margins, balancing efficiency with failure resilience.
reference_context: Defocused reflectors suffer from 4.95-5.655 dB spillover loss, impacting SNR and frequency reuse.
